subject: [PATCH v2 3/8] memcg: remove the soft limit reclaim tracepoints

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch removes two tracepoints, mm_vmscan_memcg_softlimit_reclaim_begin and mm_vmscan_memcg_softlimit_reclaim_end, which were only emitted by a function that has been removed from the codebase. The removal of these tracepoints is necessary because they can no longer fire due to the absence of the original function. This patch is part of a larger series of changes related to memory cgroup (memcg) functionality.
